nodes.name: Simpro Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives every Simpro webhook event (Site, Company customer, Contact, Quote, Job). ⚠ No auth — see Open Issues sticky.

nodes.name: Route by Simpro Event
nodes.notes: Routes on body.name. Events with any other name are dropped silently (no fallback output).

nodes.name: Get Simpro Site
nodes.notes: Fetches the full Site from Simpro (incl. Customers[] and PrimaryContact) — the webhook only carries the ID.

nodes.name: Get Site-Contact Associations
nodes.notes: Lists the primary contact links the HubSpot record has now. Compared after the upsert.

nodes.name: Archive Site-Contact Associations
nodes.notes: Unlinks only the primary contact Simpro no longer has (one batch call). Linked ones are left alone.

nodes.name: Upsert Site in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: creates/updates the HubSpot Site (0-420) keyed on simpro_site_id. Returns the HubSpot record (id).

nodes.name: Upsert Site Primary Contact
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: upserts the Site's PrimaryContact from Simpro. Fails if the site has no primary contact.

nodes.name: Get Site-Company Associations
nodes.notes: Lists companies currently linked in HubSpot. Compared with Simpro after the loop.

nodes.name: Archive Site-Company Associations
nodes.notes: Unlinks only the companies Simpro no longer has (one batch call). Linked ones are left alone.

nodes.name: Upsert Site Customer
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow: upserts this company in HubSpot and returns its id, then back to the loop.

nodes.name: Loop Over Site Customers
nodes.notes: One company at a time. Output 0 (done) carries every upserted HubSpot id to the plan.

parameters.content:
## 🏗 Site event
Upsert Site → compare links with Simpro: keep matches, remove stale, add missing for the Primary Contact and for every Customer (upserted one at a time in **Loop Over Site Customers**).

## 🏢 Company customer event
Upsert Company → compare links with Simpro: keep matches, remove stale, add missing for every Contact and every Site (two loops).

## 👤 Contact event
Upsert Contact → compare links with Simpro: keep matches, remove stale, add missing for every Customer (Company) and every Site (two loops).

## 📄 Quote event
Upsert Quote Deal → compare links with Simpro: keep matches, remove stale, add missing for its Site, Contact and Company (three parallel branches, no loops).

## 🔧 Job event
Upsert Job Deal → compare links with Simpro: keep matches, remove stale, add missing for its Site, Contact and Company (three parallel branches, no loops).

nodes.name: Receive Record
nodes.notes: Called once per changed record by [SPL] Simpro -> HubSpot Poller. Input data mode must read 'Accept all data'. Item shape matches the old webhook: { body: { name, reference } }.

nodes.name: Simpro Site Has Customers
nodes.notes: True → upsert each company first. False → Simpro has none, so every current HubSpot link is stale.

nodes.name: List Simpro Site Customers
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: one item per company on the Simpro site.

nodes.name: Plan Site-Company Changes
nodes.notes: Diffs current HubSpot companies links against Simpro. Outputs a remove item and/or an add item; none when already in sync.

nodes.name: Route Site-Company Changes
nodes.notes: Remove → unlink companies that Simpro no longer has. Add → link companies that are missing. Nothing to change = no items = branch ends here.

nodes.name: Create Missing Site-Company Associations
nodes.notes: Links only the companies that are missing (one batch call, default association type).

nodes.notes: Sub-workflow [SPL] Check Simpro Test Record: fetches the Simpro record and returns the event plus isTestRecord. Re-select the sub-workflow here after importing it.

nodes.name: Is HS Test Record
nodes.notes: True → name starts with 'HS TEST - ', sync it. False → skip (nothing is written to HubSpot).

nodes.name: Skip Non-Test Record
nodes.notes: The record name does not start with 'HS TEST - '. Ends here on purpose.
